info.title: Recoup API - Sessions
info.description: Sessions — sandboxed runs of an LLM-driven agent with tool use, lifecycle hooks, and persistence. Each session pairs one Vercel Sandbox with one or more chat threads.

post.description: Creates a new agent session and an initial empty chat in a single transaction. The session is created in the `provisioning` lifecycle state — a separate orchestration step claims it and starts the sandbox.

200.description: Session and initial chat created successfully.

400.description: Invalid request body — either malformed JSON or a field failed validation.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key / Bearer token.

500.description: Server error — the session could not be persisted.

get.description: **Authentication:** Send **exactly one** of `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer <privy-access-token>`. Sending **both** headers or **neither** yields **401** (Recoup API `validateAuthContext`). Returns a single agent session by its id.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The id of the session to fetch.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing credentials, or ambiguous authentication (both `x-api-key` and `Authorization` were sent, or neither was sent). Response body uses `{ "status": "error", "error": "..." }`.

403.description: Forbidden - the authenticated account does not own this session

404.description: Not found - no session exists with the given id

get.description: **Authentication:** Send **exactly one** of `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer <privy-access-token>`. Sending **both** headers or **neither** yields **401** (Recoup API `validateAuthContext`). The session must exist (**404**) and belong to the authenticated account (**403**). Lists every chat in the given session as a `ChatSummary` (chat row plus per-account `hasUnread` and `isStreaming` flags), along with the caller's default model id. Chats are sorted by `createdAt` ascending.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The id of the parent session.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing credentials, or ambiguous authentication (both `x-api-key` and `Authorization` were sent, or neither was sent). Response body uses `{ "status": "error", "error": "..." }`.

403.description: Forbidden — the authenticated account does not own this session.

404.description: Not found — no session exists with the given id.

post.description: **Authentication:** Same as `GET` on this path — **exactly one** of `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer <privy-access-token>`; both or neither → **401** (`validateAuthContext`). Session must exist and be owned by the caller (**404** / **403**). Creates a new chat inside the given session. Callers may pass `{ id }` to claim a deterministic chat id — useful for optimistic UI flows where the client generates the id locally and then persists it. If a chat with that id already exists in **this** session the call is idempotent and returns the existing row; if it exists in **another** session, 409 is returned.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The id of the parent session.

200.description: Chat created, or existing chat returned (idempotent on same-session reuse).

400.description: Invalid chat id — body contained `id` but it was an empty string or not a string.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing credentials, or ambiguous authentication (both `x-api-key` and `Authorization` were sent, or neither was sent). Response body uses `{ "status": "error", "error": "..." }`.

403.description: Forbidden — the authenticated account does not own this session.

404.description: Not found — no session exists with the given id.

409.description: Chat id conflict — a chat with the requested id already exists on a different session.

500.description: Server error — the chat could not be persisted.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Personal or organization API key for server-side and automation clients.

BearerAuth.description: Privy-issued user access token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`) for browser clients (e.g. Open Agents).

CreateSessionRequest.description: All fields are optional. An empty body is valid and creates a session with default settings.

title.description: Display title for the session. When omitted, the server generates one.

repoOwner.description: GitHub repository owner (user or org). Validated against GitHub's owner-name rules.

repoName.description: GitHub repository name. Validated against GitHub's repo-name rules.

branch.description: Branch the session should check out. Ignored when `isNewBranch` is true — the server generates a new branch name in that case.

cloneUrl.description: Clone URL the sandbox should fetch from.

isNewBranch.description: When true, the server generates a fresh branch name (e.g. `xx/abcdef12`) instead of using `branch`.

sandboxType.description: Which sandbox provider to use. Currently only `vercel` is accepted.

title.description: Display title for the chat. The initial chat created with a session is titled `New chat`.

modelId.description: AI Gateway model identifier the chat is configured to use (e.g. `openai/gpt-5.4`).

activeStreamId.description: Id of an in-flight assistant stream, if one is active.

lastAssistantMessageAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent assistant message in this chat.

ChatSummary.description: Chat row enriched with per-account `hasUnread` and computed `isStreaming` flags for chat-list rendering.

hasUnread.description: True when `lastAssistantMessageAt` is newer than the caller's `chat_reads.last_read_at` (or no read row exists yet).

chats.description: Every chat in the session, sorted by `createdAt` ascending.

defaultModelId.description: Default model id surfaced to clients with no explicit preference (e.g. `openai/gpt-5.4`).

CreateSessionChatRequest.description: Body for `POST /api/sessions/{sessionId}/chats`. Both an empty body and an omitted body are valid.

id.description: Optional client-supplied chat id (used for optimistic UI flows). When omitted, the server generates a UUID. When supplied, must be a non-empty string.

userId.description: Owning account id. Named `userId` here for compatibility with existing clients; on the server side this is the account_id foreign key into the accounts table.

repoOwner.description: GitHub repo owner if the session is bound to a repository.

cloneUrl.description: Clone URL the sandbox should fetch from.

isNewBranch.description: True when this session created and pushed a new branch (not committing back to the original).

globalSkillRefs.description: Skills attached to the agent at provision time.

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle orchestration state for the sandbox.

lifecycleVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency token for lifecycle transitions.

linesAdded.description: Lines added across the session's diff. Defaults to 0; null when stats have not been computed.

linesRemoved.description: Lines removed across the session's diff. Defaults to 0; null when stats have not been computed.
